remarks: Don't miss seeing this fantastic 3 bedroom ranch located on a cul-de-sac in Mid-Ridges. The location can't be beat just minutes from the Merritt, shops, and restaurants. The walkability and convenience to everything is supreme! The house is complete with a living room, eat-in kitchen with new stainless steel refrigerator, dishwasher, & stove hood, full bathroom system, carpeting throughout, & gas burner. You'll enjoy central a/c and on cooler nights, you can sit on your outdoor patio. 1 car garage with plenty of storage plus an attic. Roof is 9 years young. The potential at 19 Corn Cake is endless - add an additional bathroom or even a second floor if desired. Come see for yourself!
